extracted.intended_audience: general public, YouTube viewers, and people interested in online content ethics and platform moderation
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluating whether a vlogger/YouTuber's video content is appropriate and ethically acceptable, especially when it involves sensitive material (e.g., suicides, tragedies). Applies to creators, platform moderators, advertisers, and concerned viewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not post footage of suicide victims / put the cameras down
rubrics_metrics.description: "I should have never posted the video. I should have put the cameras down." (Paul acknowledging he should not have posted footage showing a dead body found in Aokigahara.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creators should refrain from filming or posting footage of deceased persons or suicide victims. Sensitive scenes should not be recorded, published, or monetized; when such material is discovered, the ethical action is to stop filming, notify authorities, and respect the victim and family rather than capturing content. Example anti-pattern: continuing to film and upload a deceased suicide victim (Paul's deleted video).

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid making jokes or mocking victims in content
rubrics_metrics.description: Criticism that the video "shows a dead body of a suicide victim, uses that for the title, makes heartless jokes next to the body" and that such behavior is mocking rather than compassionate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creators must not make jokes, light-hearted commentary, or sensationalize around real tragedies or victims. Doing so demonstrates disrespect to victims and their families and invites public condemnation. Anti-patterns include titling videos to exploit the tragedy and making humorous remarks in the presence of a victim.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apologies must be sincere and not self-praising or defensive
rubrics_metrics.description: Critics called Paul's apology "self-praising," and Paul himself later said to followers 'I don't expect to be forgiven.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When issuing an apology for offensive content, avoid defensive language, self-justification, or framing the apology to curry favor (e.g., emphasizing personal impact or follower growth). A genuine apology acknowledges harm, accepts responsibility, and apologizes to victims/families and affected communities. Anti-pattern: an apology focused on the creator's feelings or perceived intent rather than the harm caused.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not exploit tragedies for views or relevancy
rubrics_metrics.description: Quote: "Logan Paul’s instinct to continue filming, continue editing, and continue uploading after filming a dead suicide victim shows just how corrupt he has become in the persuit of relevancy. You had many chances to turn back, dude. You chose this."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creators should not use real human suffering as raw material to attract views, subscribers, or relevance. If content centers on traumatic events, creators should prioritize dignity and consent, not engagement metrics. Anti-patterns include editing/uploading sensational footage to increase views despite clear opportunity to stop.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stated intent (e.g., 'raising awareness') must match actual impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Paul wrote he wanted to "raise awareness for suicide and suicide prevention," but critics argued he was "mocking" and not actually raising awareness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a creator claims public-service intent, the content must demonstrably educate, provide resources, and handle the subject sensitively. Mere invocation of 'raising awareness' does not excuse exploitative presentation. Include concrete resources or expert perspectives when covering sensitive topics. Anti-pattern: claiming altruistic intent while producing sensational or exploitative content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platforms should implement creator-specific age restrictions and consider follower demographics
rubrics_metrics.description: Public calls: "there needs to b age restrictions for certain creators. How is this allowed on YT? His followers are children!"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platform policy and enforcement should account for the demographics of a creator's audience; creators with large child audiences should be subject to stricter content controls or age gates for sensitive material. Anti-pattern: allowing creators with child-heavy followings to publish graphic or otherwise inappropriate content without additional safeguards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platforms must enforce content policies and act to remove inappropriate material/accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: The article notes YouTube was slammed for allowing Paul's video and references that YouTube "terminated hundreds of accounts and removed more than 150,000 videos" in a prior advertiser-driven purge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Platforms bear responsibility to enforce community guidelines promptly for graphic, exploitative, or hateful content; failure to act provokes public backlash and advertiser responses. Enforcement actions can include video removal, account suspension/termination, and adjustments to monetization or recommendation systems. Example: prior advertiser-driven removals and account terminations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offensive content can lead to professional and commercial consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples: "multiple big-name advertisers pulled ads on YouTube over disturbing content... YouTube terminated hundreds of accounts" and PewDiePie had a season cancelled and was removed from Google Preferred after posting anti-Semitic imagery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creators risk losing sponsorships, partnerships, TV deals, platform privileges, and ad revenue when producing offensive content. However, controversies do not always reduce subscriber counts. Stakeholders (brands, platforms) may act to distance themselves to protect reputations. Anti-pattern: assuming controversy will have only short-term reputational effects without financial or professional impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creators with wide influence must exercise personal and social awareness
rubrics_metrics.description: Critique: "The amount of personal + social unawareness Logan Paul has displayed... How could one w such power and influence have the audacity to put something so thoughtless online? You have potentially intensified an entire family's grief beyond measure."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Influencers should recognize the reach and impact of their content and act responsibly—especially on topics involving trauma, minors, or vulnerable groups. This includes anticipating harm, seeking advice from experts, and erring on the side of compassion. Anti-patterns include cavalier posting without regard for downstream effects on audiences or victims' families.
